$schema_note: L0C re-authoring overlay (lane/l0-authoring). SOURCE OF TRUTH for the interaction/answer-model/blocker/level/image metadata of all 16 Level 0C Placement Worksheet tasks. Consumed by scripts/conversion/apply-l0-overlay.ts. The 0C booklet RAMPS: tasks 1-13 are LEVEL 0B, tasks 14-16 are LEVEL 0C; banded by the Summary table LEVEL column, NOT the doc name. Existing SAM-L0C-Q<N> rows were assigned by printed task number (mapping correct) but their CONTENT was model-reconstructed and is WRONG -> re-authored from docx/crops. Held rows are authored fully but stay is_active=false (real interaction not wired). Active rows carry CLEAN content (no _authoring; the applier omits it). For updates, _authoring is auto-injected by the applier for held rows, so it is NOT placed in update.content.
